name: We Shall Meet Again Soon
game_text: <phase>Response</phase>: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert an unbound Hobbit to place a Shadow card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.
flavor_text: “‘He said: “Who are you?” I still did not answer, but it hurt me horribly; and he pressed me, so I said: “A hobbit.”’”
